meaning: From STMT-AYER-1936-CRITERION-TRIVIAL and no premises: a sentence whose negation does not entail some observation statement passes the 1936 test, so no frame satisfies the V2 exclusion thesis STMT-AYER-1936-EXCLUDES-METAPHYSICS, which this argument refutes.
